notes.title: A few small updates to Kings of Israel
notes.notes:
Just a quick update went out this past weekend for Kings of Israel, here are the changes:

-New setting for faster sin spreading 
-Gold Delivered Blessing: The game no longer gets stuck if a player has too much gold
-Fixed Brimstone typo
